```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Senate bill would add $46.3 billion in expenditure on border enforcement over the next decade.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The annual amount spent on border enforcement already exceeds the total expenditure of all other federal security agencies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Senate bill calls for doubling the number of Border Patrol agents to almost 40,000 over the next ten years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Senate bill expands the area within the United States in which Border Security can patrol.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Expanding the area in which Border Security can patrol will ramp up the unjust harassment of borderland communities.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"These programs are a financial boondoggle for military contractors and for the private prison industry.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The actions will not curtail undocumented immigration.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Senate bill continues the requirement that aspiring citizens must demonstrate English proficiency.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Senate bill provides only $100 million in additional funding for English proficiency programs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"An estimated 5.8 million legal permanent residents, and 6.4 million undocumented immigrants have limited English proficiency.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"It would take between $11.5 and $23 billion total to equip immigrants with the language skills they need.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Instead of militarizing the border, Congress should adequately fund opportunities for immigrants to learn English.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
